text: 40岁，二婚，两个女儿，大宝13岁，小宝4岁，负债累累，每天被各大平台追债，各种信息、电话轰炸，现已失业在家摆烂！
en: 40 years old, in a second marriage, with two daughters, the elder, Dabao, aged 13 and the younger, Xiaobao, aged 4, heavily in debt, chased for repayment by various platforms every day, bombarded with all sorts of messages and phone calls, and now unemployed, lying flat at home!

text: 我是个一把好牌打得稀巴烂的典型例子。
en: I am a typical example of someone who played a good hand of cards and made a thorough mess of it.

text: 2002年大专毕业，没有分配，母亲立刻在村里给我找了份小学代课的工作，工资230一，加上各种节日补贴福利一个月下来，少说也有5/600。
en: I graduated from a junior college in 2002; there was no job assignment, so my mother immediately found me a substitute teaching post at the village primary school, with a salary of 230 a month, and with various holiday subsidies and benefits added in, a month would bring in at least five or six hundred.

text: 一天两三节课，没课时可以干私事，日子虽然不富裕，但也逍遥自在。
en: Two or three lessons a day, and when there were no classes I could attend to private matters; life was not wealthy, but it was free and easy.

text: 干了一年半，学校开始统计代课老师转正名额，我算是新人，校长说名额有限，得再等两年，我一气之下辞职不干了。
en: After a year and a half, the school began to count the quota for substitute teachers to be made permanent. As a relative newcomer, I was told by the headteacher that places were limited and I would have to wait another two years, so in a fit of pique I resigned and quit.

text: 一个人只身到外面去打拼，凭着大胆和专业知识，很轻松就找到了对口的工作，在教育行业一做就是十余年。
en: I went out alone to make my way in the world; relying on boldness and specialist knowledge, I easily found a matching job, and stayed in the education industry for over ten years.

text: 积累了丰富的教学经验后，也换了几个城市，从普通教师到园长助理，再到教学主任，各项教学奖拿到手软，从而奠定了我在教育界的地位。
en: After building up rich teaching experience, I also moved through several cities, rising from an ordinary teacher to assistant to the kindergarten head, then to director of teaching, collecting teaching awards one after another, and thereby establishing my standing in the world of education.

text: 老天都是公平的，给了你甜，一定也会让你尝尝苦的滋味。
en: Heaven is fair: having given you sweetness, it will surely let you taste bitterness too.

text: 事业上一路飙升，感情上却一路红灯，先是与初恋男友分手，再就是为了摆脱相亲，仓促嫁给了前男友的同事，这无疑就是一个不明智的选择。
en: My career climbed steeply, yet my love life hit one red light after another — first I broke up with my first boyfriend, then, to escape blind dates, I hastily married a colleague of my ex-boyfriend, which was undoubtedly an unwise choice.

text: 刚生下女儿一年，在一次剧烈争吵后结束了这段短暂的婚姻。
en: Just one year after my daughter was born, this brief marriage ended following a violent quarrel.

text: 从此踏上单亲妈妈的路程。
en: From then on I set out on the road of a single mother.

text: 女儿七岁那年，网恋现任丈夫，30好几的人了，居然还相信网恋能有真感情，除了恋爱脑，就是我这种涉世未深的单亲妇女了吧！
en: When my daughter was seven, I fell in love online with my current husband. Already well past thirty, I still believed that online romance could yield real feeling — apart from being love-brained, I must be one of those single mothers who had barely seen the world!

text: 奔现两个月后领证摆酒席，期间分分合合无数次，还是铁了心要嫁给他，这就是作死的节奏！
en: Two months after we met in person we obtained our marriage certificate and held the wedding banquet. We split up and got back together countless times in between, yet I was set on marrying him — that was precisely the rhythm of courting disaster!

text: 婚后第三年，怀上了小宝，俩人的矛盾开始升级，感情失和，形同陌路。
en: In the third year of marriage I became pregnant with Xiaobao; the two of us began to see our conflicts escalate, our feelings fell out of harmony, and we became like strangers.

text: 生下小女儿后，关系有所缓和，终究是看在小女儿的份儿上勉强维持这段婚姻。
en: After the younger daughter was born, the relationship eased somewhat; in the end, for the sake of the little daughter, we reluctantly kept this marriage going.

text: 现任丈夫没什么正经工作，最大的本事就是鼓动我办理了各大银行信用卡，然后鼓吹我是一个有钱人了，他可以闲职在家专业带娃。
en: My current husband has no proper job; his greatest talent is urging me to take out credit cards from various banks, then trumpeting that I am now a wealthy woman so that he can stay at home in an idle role and professionally mind the children.

text: 信用卡真是个好东西！
en: Credit cards really are a fine thing!

text: 满足了人性对物质生活的最大欲望！
en: They satisfy the utmost craving of human nature for material life!

text: 由于我的职业关系，在银行眼里我就是高端优质客户，每一张卡一申请就有3～5万的额度，后期还有提额。
en: Because of my profession, in the eyes of the banks I was a high-end premium customer; every card, the moment I applied, came with a limit of thirty to fifty thousand, and later there were further limit increases.

text: 四大银行除了没有工商卡，加上中信、平安、交通、招商等，一共办理了六张信用卡，瞬间我成了“富婆”一样的存在。
en: Of the four major banks, barring the fact that I had no ICBC card, and adding CITIC, Ping An, Bank of Communications, China Merchants and others, I took out six credit cards in all, and in an instant I became an existence akin to a "rich woman".

text: 从来没有在不劳而获的过程中一下子拥有这么多 ，我飘飘然了好长一段时间。
en: I had never, in the course of getting something for nothing, suddenly possessed so much; I was walking on air for a good long while.

text: 以前舍不得买的品牌鞋服，现在终于可以买买买了，没体验过的五星级酒店服务，如今每个月去一次，美其名曰犒劳一下辛苦工作的自己。
en: Brand-name shoes and clothes I had once grudged buying I can now at last buy, buy, buy; five-star hotel services I had never tried, I now visit once a month, under the fine-sounding pretext of rewarding myself for hard work.

text: 工作上因为有了物质基础的加持，人际关系混得更是风生水起，同事们投来羡慕嫉妒恨的眼神，大大满足了我潜在的虚荣心。
en: At work, with the backing of a material foundation, my interpersonal relationships flourished all the more; colleagues cast looks of envy, jealousy and hatred, greatly indulging my latent vanity.

text: 这种日子快活了一年多后，资金缺口开始断裂，有限的工资难以填补超前消费的空缺，慢慢变得入不敷出。
en: After more than a year of such happy days, the funding gap began to crack open; my limited salary could hardly fill the void left by advance consumption, and gradually I could no longer make ends meet.

text: 眼看每个月的资金缺口越来越大，我开始有点慌，跟现任丈夫商量，他给你来一句，怕什么，可以每张卡片倒着用，一下子就解决了每个月的还款压力，我对他使出的招儿佩服得五体投地！
en: Watching the monthly funding gap grow ever larger, I began to feel a little panicky and consulted my current husband; he offered, 'What is there to fear? You can run each card in rotation, and that instantly dissolves the monthly repayment pressure' — I was filled with admiration for the trick he produced!

text: 这样以卡养卡的一年里，我们就像过上了神仙般的生活！
en: During that year of using one card to feed another, we lived like immortals!

text: 租住在高档小区里，出行有车，一家四口其乐融融，每周打卡星级酒店自助餐、各个旅游景点，好不惬意！
en: We rented in a high-end estate, had a car for getting about, the family of four was cheerful and content, and every week we checked in at star-rated hotel buffets and various tourist sights — how utterly delightful!

text: 超前消费的一时爽终于迎来了反噬！
en: The momentary thrill of advance consumption finally met its backlash!

text: 去年开始以卡养卡也堵不住巨大缺口了，于是逾期如期而至！
en: From last year, even using one card to feed another could no longer plug the enormous gap, and so overdue payments arrived right on cue!

text: 刚开始出现逾期时还想方设法填补缺口，到处周转资金，跟私人借了近十万，网贷五万，本以为熬一熬就过去了，谁知，这么大的缺口并不是熬就能过去的！
en: When the overdues first appeared I still tried every means to plug the gap, scrambling for funds everywhere, borrowing nearly a hundred thousand from private individuals and fifty thousand through online lending; I thought I could simply tough it out and pass through, but who knew such a vast gap could not be survived by mere endurance!

text: 后期逾期催收电话不停地轰炸！
en: Later, the overdue debt-collection calls bombarded me without cease!

text: 扰得我每天失魂落魄，工作也无法投入，导致效率低下，人也精神恍惚，家里的气氛也变得紧张起来。
en: They left me distracted and hollow every day; I could not devote myself to work, my efficiency dropped, my mind grew foggy, and the atmosphere at home turned tense.

text: 这样的日子维持了半年，我身心俱疲！
en: This way of life persisted for half a year, and I was spent in body and mind!

text: 终于鼓起勇气跟各大银行协商，争取尽早上岸…
en: At last I plucked up the courage to negotiate with the various banks, striving to climb out of debt as soon as possible…

text: 如今的我，就是一个负债累累的40岁中年妇女，每天睡梦中都在想着怎么一夜暴富，还清所有债务，然后一切从头开始！
en: I am now a debt-laden forty-year-old woman in middle age; every night in my dreams I am scheming how to grow rich overnight, clear all my debts, and then begin everything anew!

text: 那也只是做做梦而已！
en: But that is only a dream!

text: 人生没有捷径，每一步走来都会留下印迹。
en: Life has no short cut; every step taken leaves its mark.

text: 我在这里写下这段文字，奉劝那些还在以卡养卡、以贷养贷的人们，赶紧悬崖勒马，回头是岸啊！
en: I set down these words here to urge those who are still using one card to feed another or one loan to feed another: rein in your horse at the cliff's edge — turn back, and there is shore!

text: 【关注我，一天一个真实故事！
en: 【Follow me, one true story every day!

text: 白百何在电视剧中有段台词，我看了好几遍，让人深思：
en: Baihe Bai has a line in a television drama that I have watched several times, and it gives one much to ponder:

text: 有人说，人过30，为自己而活的人生就结束了，所有的自恋和做作都应该有所收敛，所有的追求和理想都应该为了老公孩子和父母，只要他们衣食无忧平安健康，你就不应另有所求。
en: Some say that once a person passes thirty, the life of living for oneself is over; all narcissism and affectation should be reined in, and all pursuit and ideals should be for one's husband, children and parents — so long as they are clothed and fed without care and are safe and well, you should ask for nothing more.

text: 说出这句话的人，不知道是受了多少苦，受了什么罪，积攒了多少失望，才总结出来的。
en: Whoever spoke those words must have endured no little suffering and hardship and accumulated no little disappointment before distilling this conclusion.

text: 现在我心里只有一句话，这世界上没有什么天经地义和理所当然，是不是人到中年，在心不在年龄。
en: Now I have but one sentence in my heart: in this world there is nothing fixed or taken for granted; whether one has reached middle age lies in the heart, not in years.

text: 是啊，人到中年，为别人活着，好像就已经是生活的主旨。
en: Indeed, once one reaches middle age, living for others seems already to be the very theme of life.

text: 他们能够活得好好的，家庭又如常地运转一天，就让人长吁一口气，一个中年人，哪里还敢奢望什么别的？
en: That they can live on soundly and the household runs as usual for another day is enough to draw a long breath of relief from a middle-aged person — how could such a one dare to hope for anything else?

text: 但自己都没有的人，又哪里有能量去爱别人呢？
en: But one who does not even have oneself — where would such a person find the energy to love others?

text: 越到中年，我越感觉到，真正的赢家不是所谓的有车有房，有这个，有那个，而是一个人还有心气，还有能量。
en: The further into middle age I go, the more I feel that the true winner is not the so-called person with a car and a house, with this and with that, but one who still has spirit and still has energy.

text: 这种能量，让人感觉你是始终积极的、向上的、不放弃自己的，是不在乎年龄感的，是意气风发的。
en: This energy makes you feel consistently positive, upward-striving, unwilling to give up on yourself; untroubled by any sense of age, and full of vigour.

text: 多少中年人，被生活已经干趴下了。
en: How many middle-aged people have already been beaten flat by life.

text: 而如果此时你还拥有一种高能量，你就能活出不一样的气场。
en: Yet if at this moment you still possess a high energy, you can live out a different aura.

text: 即使你现在啥也没有，这种气场，也一定能够带领你走出低谷，让人生越走越开阔。
en: Even if you now have absolutely nothing, this aura will surely lead you out of the trough and let life open up ever wider.

text: 作家冯唐也说过，人的能量，比情商、智商更重要。
en: The writer Tang Feng also said that a person's energy matters more than emotional intelligence or IQ.

text: 那如果现在能量场就低，该怎么办呢？
en: Then if one's energy field is low right now, what is to be done?

text: 1、悲观失望、闷闷不乐时，不要窝在家里，多出去走走。
en: 1. When pessimistic, disappointed and downcast, do not mope at home; go out and walk more.

text: 看日落，看花朵，看人间烟火，让生活给你补充。
en: Watch the sunset, watch the blossoms, watch the bustle of the world, and let life replenish you.

text: 作家毛姆icon也说过：一个人能观察落叶、鲜花，从细微处欣赏一切，生活就不能把他怎么样。
en: The writer Maugham also said: one who can observe falling leaves and fresh flowers and appreciate everything in its fine details cannot be got the better of by life.

text: 2、早睡早起，适当运动。
en: 2. Sleep early and rise early, and take appropriate exercise.

text: 一个简单的习惯，就能改变一个人的能量场。
en: A simple habit can change a person's energy field.

text: 当你身体越来越健康，你就会越来越神清气爽。
en: As your body grows healthier, you will become ever more clear-headed and refreshed.

text: 早上醒来，伸个懒腰，你会感觉世界都在你的手中。
en: When you wake in the morning and stretch, you will feel the whole world is in your hands.

text: 3、多和正能量、能量高的人在一起。
en: 3. Spend more time with positive-energy, high-energy people.

text: 如刘震云所说：要跟能从他身上，得到温暖和教益的人相处。
en: As Zhenyun Liu said: keep company with those from whom you can draw warmth and edification.

text: 别人积极生活的态度，会让你也跟着动起来。
en: Others' attitude of living positively will set you moving too.

text: 说到底，中年危机，最大的危机，是自己的心已经死去，能量已经散去。
en: At bottom, the greatest crisis of the mid-life crisis is that one's own heart has already died and one's energy has already dispersed.

text: 只要自己有健康、有心力、有活力，年龄就不是问题，你随时还有时间成为更好的自己。
en: So long as you have health, have heart, have vitality, age is no problem; you always still have time to become a better version of yourself.

text: 共勉！
en: Let us take heart together!
